---
title: "YouTube Engagement Analytics Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: column
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(corrplot)

video_stats <- read.delim(
  "videos-stats.csv",
  sep = ",",
  strip.white = TRUE
)

video_stats <- video_stats %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    LikesPer1k = round(Likes/(Views/1000),2),
    CommentsPer1k = round(Comments/(Views/1000),2),
    TitleLen = nchar(Title),
    PubYear = as.factor(substr(Published.At,1,4)),
    Published.At = as.POSIXct(
      Published.At,
      format="%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  )
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Likes vs Comments per 1k Views

```{r}
video_stats %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~LikesPer1k,
    y = ~CommentsPer1k,
    color = ~Keyword,
    size = ~Views,
    sizes = c(5,70),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(
      opacity = 0.6,
      sizemode = "diameter"
    ),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = ~paste(
      paste0("<b>", Title, "</b>"),
      paste0("<br>Category: ", Keyword),
      paste0("<br>Views: ", format(Views,big.mark=",")),
      paste0("<br>Likes / 1k: ", LikesPer1k),
      paste0("<br>Comments / 1k: ", CommentsPer1k)
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Likes vs Comments per 1k Views",
    xaxis = list(title="Likes per 1k Views"),
    yaxis = list(title="Comments per 1k Views")
  )
```

### Correlation Matrix

```{r}
corr_matrix <- cor(
  video_stats[,c(
    "Views",
    "Likes",
    "Comments",
    "LikesPer1k",
    "CommentsPer1k",
    "TitleLen"
  )]
)

corrplot(
  corr_matrix,
  method="color",
  type="upper",
  addCoef.col="black",
  number.cex=0.7,
  tl.cex=0.8
)
```
Row
-------------------------------------

### Total Comments by Category Over Time

```{r}
comments_trend <- video_stats %>%
  group_by(PubYear, Keyword) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalComments = sum(Comments)/1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplotly(
  ggplot(
    comments_trend,
    aes(
      x = PubYear,
      y = TotalComments,
      color = Keyword,
      group = Keyword
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Total Comments by Category Over Time",
      x = "Publication Year",
      y = "Comments (Thousands)"
    )
)
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Average Likes per 1k Views by Category

```{r}
video_stats %>%
  group_by(Keyword) %>%
  summarise(
    AvgLikes = mean(LikesPer1k),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AvgLikes)) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Keyword, AvgLikes),
      y = AvgLikes,
      fill = Keyword
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Likes per 1k Views",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Likes per 1k Views"
  )
```
